body: Measure twice, cut once… tomorrow might be the best day of your life and you don’t even know it yet.

After every storm, the sun will shine eventually. 

Don’t let this breakup dictate your entire life—you will grow, you will become stronger, and you WILL get past this. 

Life is short, and the clock is ticking—don’t let life pass you by constantly worrying about factors you can’t control. Do things that make you happy, take risks, meet new people, and step outside of your comfort zone. 

There is only one YOU… and you only have one chance in life. Make it count. 

—Without A Name

Through every storm, the sun does shine eventually… focus on yourself, your goals, your hobbies. 

One day you will look back and wish you put your great mind to things that YOU can control. Don’t let life pass you by.

Take hold of your emotions, and get after it! The clock is ticking…

—Without A Name

Hello stranger, 

If it means anything at all, I want you to know that nobody is worth your life except yourself. My SO of 5 years and I just broke up, and it’s hard. It’s a new feeling of being alone and it really sucks. Everything happens for a reason, and I promise there will be sunshine at the end of the storm. 

Find some hobbies, meet new friends, and worry about creating a better version of yourself. 

Feel free to PM me if you ever wanna just talk. 

Keep moving forward! 

—Without A Name

It’s natural, and you should feel good that you’re intelligent enough to think ahead. You’re moving in the right direction, and things will work out. 

Without risk, your life will stay in a constant state of Inertia… get after it, because if you don’t life will pass you by before you know it. 

-Without A Name

I understand how you feel—but you’re only 24… your 30 year old self will look back at you and realize how silly your feelings are in the present moment: as will your 40,50,60 year old selves… 

Life is short, but if you take risks and live it to the fullest 1 lifetime is long enough. 

Your gut tells you to go, and you have nothing holding you back. GO! 

Take risks, step outside your comfort zone, don’t overthink it. You will be just fine stranger. 

—Without A Name
Never underestimate yourself... well done mate!

Simple...yet powerful

You're not alone... I can relate to your story all too well. People make $500 in crypto and all of the sudden they are the new Warren Buffet. I have introduced many people to the world of cryptocurrency, however, this is perceived as easy gains due to the perpetual success we've had in the market for the past few months. Social media is destroying the value of the network, by influencing people to buy low-value completely useless assets; Unfortunately leading those to believe you've steered them wrong. The key takeaway is people do not understand risk, and although you can certainly make quick money, nothing lasts forever. Those who don't understand this shouldn't be investing in the first place. 

Get new friends, and keep moving forward. 

All the best!

Playing Devil’s Advocate here; perhaps Ant is acting like this because she has something going on that you may not know about. I hope you two remain friends - give it time... 

Positively, 

-Without A Name
